title_zh: Environmental problems — 第44节可背诵讲义
body_en: Plastic in rivers hurts fish and birds. Carry a reusable bottle and bag. Write a short poster with three green ideas in English. Ask your family to try one idea for a week. Protecting the earth is daily work, not only a big word on a wall.
body_zh: 河里的塑料伤害鱼和鸟。带可重复使用的瓶子和袋子。用英语写一张写着三条绿色想法的短海报。请家人一周试行一条。保护地球是日常工作，而不只是墙上的大话。
